## Purpose

Describe the scientific or software problem and the narrow change made.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant unit tests pass
- [ ] Compilation/import checks pass
- [ ] Dataset audit was run when data or training behavior changed
- [ ] No patient-identifiable data, credentials, raw clinical files, or private links were added
- [ ] Model/data/documentation claims match generated evidence
- [ ] Licensing and provenance effects are documented

## Evidence and limitations

List commands executed, outputs reviewed, and anything that could not be verified.
